__broaden__.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly; adv. from αἰνός, intensifying a verb of feeling: αἰνῶς δείδοικα ’I am terribly afraid’ · also intensifying a verb of likeness: ’terribly like’ (αἰνῶς … ἔοικεν ’is terribly like’)
__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’)
__broaden__.βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself)
__broaden__.βοῶπις: βοῶπις — ox-eyed, with the eyes of a cow; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Hera · also epithet of a mortal woman, Clymene: ’ox-eyed’
